decisions.selection: Python 3.12 Protocol + JSON object at in-process service boundary; provider bridges may use async or other internal transport; I4 only called by accepted worker
alternatives: Framework model types as shared canonical schema
decisions.reason: Current isolated Python bootstrap passed, common types are JSON and physical separation not required. Minimal provider contracts avoid mandatory framework or distributed infrastructure.
decisions.review: R02/R03/R05 confirm concrete provider signatures/transport; change only by shared review.
decisions.revisit_when: Provider requires process isolation, streaming or latency constraints.

decisions.selection: Use pinned named Draft 2020-12 schema with explicit profile schema; product server uses common contracts/validation.py (jsonschema 4.25.1 pinned in product lock); no second authoritative schema engine. Module error mapping and business guards remain local.
decisions.reason: Standards-based validation avoids drift; replay agreement is not general equivalence. Product lock supplied by PD-02; standard server validator reuse is default.
decisions.review: R03 and other server providers confirm shared validator integration; any alternative engine needs evidence, divergence tests and R01 review. See HRESP-20261125-04. Frontend UX checks are not server authority.
decisions.revisit_when: Missing schema constraints, incompatible profile or performance need.

decisions.selection: Split store coordinator/gateway capabilities; runtime owns opaque context/permit; adapter gets bound gateway only; no actual permit stub
decisions.reason: Retain logical owner/atomicity and deny bypass; actual registry/lease implementation remains provider responsibility.
decisions.review: R03/R05 confirm storage transaction signatures, fence/finalize return, adapter registry and operation binding.
decisions.revisit_when: Real implementation cannot enforce atomic guard or adapter needs additional typed operation.

decisions.selection: Framework-neutral viewer mount/dispose with AuthGrant and event callback; transport/client package remains open
alternatives: Direct remote URL or browser control from UI
decisions.reason: UI can design independent of remote stack, grant and detach semantics retained.
decisions.review: R04/R05 jointly decide transport and owner/generation/origin binding.

decisions.selection: Explicit provider injection and exact synthetic replay; no automatic replay fallback in product, no fake workflow
decisions.reason: Validate edges early while avoiding competing CO implementation. Actual stateful flow needs R03 app and genuine providers.
decisions.review: Owner factory signatures, shared launch configuration and module-level testing strategy before actual assembly.
